title: Amelia | Maxi Dress with Timeless Character
bodyHtml:
Effortless vintage charm meets everyday comfort in this maxi dress that's impossibly easy to wear. The soft, washed finish gives it that lived-in character without feeling heavy, while the relaxed fit moves with you from morning to night. Perfect for warm days when you want to look polished but feel completely at ease.

Why you'll love it

  • Soft, washed finish that has natural character and never dates
  • Maxi length with gentle drape that skims without clinging
  • All-day comfort — relaxed enough to live in, polished enough to wear anywhere
  • Deep pockets because practicality matters just as much as style
  • Works year-round: pair with sandals on warm days, throw on a linen jacket when it cools down
  • Sizing from XS to 2XL, designed to flatter every shape
  • 30-day happiness guarantee — if it's not for you, we'll sort it

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
